# 选择标准的实证依据

状态日期：2026-08-14。这些案例用于推导任务形态，不用成功个案外推总体成功率。

| 案例 | 观察 | 对选题的含义 | 不能忽略的限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| [FunSearch](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-023-06924-6) | new finite constructions through short programs and a fast scoring function | prefer compact candidates, dense feedback and a deterministic final checker | record improvement is not the same as settling the surrounding conjecture |
| [AlphaEvolve](https://deepmind.google/blog/alphaevolve-a-gemini-powered-coding-agent-for-designing-advanced-algorithms/) | algorithmic search improved some matrix, geometry and combinatorial records | construction and optimization tasks with executable evaluators are the strongest current default | evaluators can be exploited; numeric candidates need exact or interval certification |
| [AlphaProof Nexus open-problem sweep](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22763) | reported proofs for 9 of 353 formalized Erdős problems and 44 of 492 OEIS statements | Lean proof search works best on decomposable statements supported by mature libraries | the study found mistranslations and drafts that merely moved the hard step into an unproved lemma |
| [OEIS Open Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.11941) | low-cost generic agents reportedly resolved 147 of 492 autoformalized conjectures | large formal pools are useful for screening and proof closure | importance is uneven, references are often sparse, and formalization fidelity must be audited |
| [Disproof of an Erdős unit-distance conjecture](https://openai.com/index/model-disproves-discrete-geometry-conjecture/) | a natural-language research agent proposed a high-value construction and proof that external mathematicians checked | reserve a minority track for precise, high-value non-formal problems with expert review | human verification and exposition remained essential, and the broader asymptotic problem was not closed |
| [Aletheia Erdős sweep](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22401) | bulk generation produced many superficially plausible answers | status, intended meaning and novelty review are more important than raw solve counts | of 200 adjudicated candidates reported in the paper, only 13 addressed the intended problem, and some were already known |
| [Formal determination of BB(5)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.12337) | a massive search was decomposed into machine-level certificates checked in Coq | large questions become agent-suitable when split into independently certifiable classes | certificate engineering and trusted-computing-base review are substantial research work |
